scripts.build: cd apps/desktop && dotenv -- pnpm tauri build && copy src-tauri\target\release\applio-app.exe ..\..\build\applio-app.exe && cd ..\server && call ./env/scripts/activate.bat && pyinstaller --onefile --icon=logo.ico --noconsole --add-data ".env;." server.py && copy dist\server.exe ..\..\build\server.exe && call ./env/scripts/deactivate.bat
scripts.build:server: cd apps/server && call ./env/scripts/activate.bat && pyinstaller --onefile --icon=logo.ico --noconsole --add-data ".env;." server.py && copy dist\server.exe ..\..\build\server.exe && call ./env/scripts/deactivate.bat
scripts.build:installer: cd apps/installer && pnpm tauri build && copy src-tauri\target\release\installer-applio-app.exe ..\..\build\install-applio-app.exe
scripts.server: cd apps/server && env\Scripts\activate && call ./env/scripts/activate.bat && python server.py
